Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 1125 AM EST Sun Nov 1 2026

- Mild and mostly cloudy through early next week.

- Warmer on Tuesday with an increasing chance of rain mid-week.

&&

.AVIATION...

The 12Z DTX sounding showed very dry air in the low levels, courtesy 
of the strong high pressure system centered over the Mid Atlantic. 
The region of low level dry air will persist across Se Mi through 
daybreak Monday. Meanwhile, west-southwest flow aloft will sustain 
an influx of higher based clouds through the TAF period. The 
gradient flow will support continued light south-southeast winds 
into Monday morning. 

For DTW...Available guidance and regional observations indicate high 
probabilities that ceiling heights will remain above 5000 feet today 
and tonight. Sub 5000 ft cloud based courtesy of low level moisture 
advection will arrive late Monday morning morning as a more 
southerly flow drives the low level moisture now residing across the 
Lower Ohio Valley into Se Mi. 

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* High in ceilings aob 5000 ft late Monday morning and afternoon.
